errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that all three lines start at an answer popularity of 0. The first data point for each series is visibly greater than 0, at approximately 10 on the x-axis.

The description incorrectly states that the peak value for all three metrics (Accuracy, Confidence, Alignment) occurs at an answer popularity of 200. In the plot, the peak for all three lines is visibly after 200, at approximately 215.

The description incorrectly states that the final data point for all three lines is at an answer popularity of 300. The plot shows the last data point for each series is clearly before 300, at approximately 290.
The first data point for the Accuracy line is not at Answer Popularity 0. It is at an x-value of approximately 10. The chart shows no data points at x=0.
The peak of the Accuracy (blue) line is not at Answer Popularity 200. The peak occurs at a value closer to 215.
The last data point for the Accuracy (blue) line is at Answer Popularity 290, not 300.
The peak of the Alignment (red) line is not at Answer Popularity 200. The peak occurs at a value closer to 215.
The last data point for the Alignment (red) line is at Answer Popularity 290, not 300.
